title: Kodavr manifesto: raw experience your agent reads for you
summary: Kodavr publishes raw experience as machine-readable dumps: the author documents what worked without polishing it, and the reader's agent adapts it. This first dump is the platform's own case study — the problem, the contract, the naming traps and the artifacts.
